Name: RoseDryad's Fairies (Custom Critters)
Author: RoseDryad
Description:
5 different variations. They appear in the farm, town, forest, bus stop, mountain, woods, and secret woods during spring, summer, and fall.

[b][u]Requirements:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255/]Custom Critters[/url]
[/list]
[b][u]Instructions:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Unzip the file and put the [b]rosedryad.fairies[/b] folder into the [b]Custom Critters/Critters[/b] folder.
[/list]
[b][u]Note:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]The fairies are not able to face different directions with the Custom Critters framework. I'll look into making a version using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url]﻿ later.
[/list]
[b][u]Customization:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]In the [b]rosedryad.fairies[/b] folder, you'll find a [b]critter.json[/b]. Open it with Notepad or of the like.
[*]Find "SpawnConditions".
[*]Seasons: By default, it is set to spring, summer, and fall. You can change it to any or all of the seasons. [code]["spring", "summer", "fall", "winter"][/code][i] [/i]
[*]Locations: [code][ "Farm", "FarmHouse", "FarmCave", "Greenhouse", "Town", "Forest", "BusStop", "Woods", "Backwoods", "Mountain" ][/code]
You can remove any of the locations or add more. [*]Find "SpawnAttempts".
[*]To change how much they spawn, increase or decrease the number. The default is set to 25.
[b]Note:[/b] Make sure to save the file as .json and not as .txt[/list]
[b][u][b][u]Recommended to use with:[/u][/b][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10154]RoseDryad's Fairydew[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10236/](FS) RoseDryad's Fairy Wings & Accessories[/url]﻿﻿
[/list][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10154]
